Best value of the lot is the MSI Modern 14 (C7M-062IN): a newer Ryzen 5 and 16GB memory for ₹43,219.

Laptop	Price	Processor	Memory / storage
MSI Modern 14 C7M-062IN	₹43,219	Ryzen 5 7530U	16GB / 512GB SSD
Acer Aspire Lite AL15-41	₹42,990	Ryzen 5 5625U (older)	8GB / 512GB SSD
Dell DC15255	₹47,990	Ryzen 5 7520U	8GB / 512GB SSD
The Acer is ₹229 cheaper than the MSI, but it has an older processor and half the memory.
The Dell costs about ₹4,771 more than the MSI for less memory.

The prices come from one list on Smartprix, so check the shop price before you buy. The MSI was first listed in Mar 2023, so stock may be limited.
